description: Phase C — Locked overrides Normal mode (regression guard). 16-frame PNG sequence in Loop mode but with sectionBehavior=Locked. Section break at timeline frame 8. Locked clips skip continuation entirely: SectionScheduler does not seed ClipPlaybackPhase, so mapToMediaFrame falls back to the timeline-derived path. With timeline paused at frame 8, mediaFrame stays at source 8 forever no matter how long we wait. This guards the 'Locked overrides PlaybackMode' invariant -- without it, the Loop branch would have continued cycling.
